description: Backfill a typed table from raw purchase events whose JSON payload (stored as STRING) changed shape three times. There is no version column; detect the shape from the keys. v1: {"price": "12.50", "qty": 2} (price is a string, per unit). v2: {"pricing": {"amount": 8.0, "currency": "USD"}, "quantity": 3} (amount per unit). v3: {"items": [{"amount": 5, "quantity": 1}, ...]} (several lines). For each event output the detected schema_version, total_amount = sum of unit amount * quantity, total_quantity, and parse_ok. Payloads that are not valid JSON or match no known shape must be kept with schema_version = 'unknown', NULL totals and parse_ok = FALSE (the query must not fail). Output columns: event_id (INT64), schema_version (STRING), total_amount (FLOAT64), total_quantity (INT64), parse_ok (BOOL). Sort by event_id.

payload.description: JSON document as text; shape depends on producer version; may be malformed

edge_cases: v1 price is a JSON string and must be cast to a number
v3 has an array of items that must be aggregated back to one row per event
Malformed JSON (event 4) must not abort the query and must stay in the output
A v3 event with an empty items array yields total_amount 0 and total_quantity 0, still one row
common_failure_modes: FM5: Reading only $.price returns NULL for v2/v3 events, silently zeroing revenue after the producer upgrade

FM4: PARSE_JSON raises on malformed input (SAFE.PARSE_JSON needed); JSON_EXTRACT returns quoted JSON text whereas JSON_VALUE returns the scalar; JSON_VALUE on an array returns NULL (JSON_QUERY_ARRAY needed)
FM1: UNNEST of the items array without re-aggregation multiplies events; comma-join UNNEST drops events with no items
